description: This Java class 'ModuleFactory' manages the lifecycle of modules in the OpenMRS platform, including loading, starting, stopping, updating, and unloading modules. It also manages module dependencies, class loaders, extensions, privileges, global properties, and interactions with the database during module operations.

classes.name: ModuleFactory
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle and dependencies of modules in OpenMRS, including loading, starting, stopping, and unloading modules, as well as managing extensions, privileges, dependencies, and database updates.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Loads a module from a file object, parsing the module, and adding it to the system, optionally replacing existing modules of the same ID.

methods.name: loadModules
methods.description: Loads all modules from the module repository directory.

methods.name: startModule
methods.description: Starts a specified module, initializing its classloader, extensions, database scripts, and activation procedures.

methods.name: stopModule
methods.description: Stops a specified module, cleaning up extensions, advice, and classloaders, and invoking shutdown procedures.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads a module, stopping it if necessary, removing it from loaded modules, and deleting associated files.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of extensions for a specified extension point, optionally filtered by media type.

methods.name: getPrivileges
methods.description: Returns a list of privileges required by all started modules.

methods.name: getGlobalProperties
methods.description: Returns all globally defined properties required by modules.

methods.name: getModuleById
methods.description: Retrieves a loaded module by its ID.

methods.name: getStartedModuleById
methods.description: Retrieves a started module by its ID.

methods.name: getModuleByPackage
methods.description: Finds a loaded module by its package name.

methods.name: getModuleClassLoader
methods.description: Returns the classloader associated with a module.

methods.name: getModuleClassLoaderMap
methods.description: Returns a map of modules to their classloaders.

methods.name: isModuleStarted
methods.description: Checks whether a module is in the started modules list.

methods.name: updateModule
methods.description: Downloads, unloads the old module, and loads/start a new version of the module.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns a list of modules that depend on a specified module.
